description: Study-site level clinical trial data including study identifiers, site details, site operational status, IRB/EC information, approval dates, protocol revision status, and history summaries. No patient-level records; professional/site identifiers and contact details only.

study.label: Source Study ID
study.description: The unique identifier for the parent clinical study as assigned by the source system.

title.label: Study Title
title.description: The descriptive title or name of the clinical study.

site_code.label: Site Code
site_code.description: The unique site identifier assigned by the source system for a participating or nominated clinical trial site.

site_name.label: Site Name
site_name.description: The official or source-system name of the clinical trial site or institution.

site_address.label: Site Address
site_address.description: The primary street address for the clinical trial site.

site_city.label: Site City
site_city.description: The city where the clinical trial site is located.

site_state.label: Site State/Province
site_state.description: The state, province, region, or source-system geographic code for the clinical trial site.

site_zip.label: Site Postal Code
site_zip.description: The postal or ZIP code for the clinical trial site.

site_country.label: Site Country
site_country.description: The country where the clinical trial site is located.

site_status.label: Site Status
site_status.description: The current operational status of the clinical trial site in the study. Observed categories/values in this file: ACTIVATED, APPROACH, CLOSED, COMPLIANCE/REG HOLD, DECLINED, END ENROLL, ENROLLING, HOLD, INA WTHDRN, NOMINATED, NOT OFFERED, PENDING, PRE CLOSE, WAIT LIST, WITHDRAWN.

site_status_date.label: Site Status Date
site_status_date.description: The date associated with the current site status.

site_cra_name.label: Site CRA Name
site_cra_name.description: The clinical research associate assigned to the site, when available.

irb_chairman_name.label: IRB/EC Chair Name
irb_chairman_name.description: The name of the IRB or ethics committee chairperson associated with the site, when available.

irb_name.label: IRB/EC Name
irb_name.description: The name of the institutional review board or ethics committee responsible for oversight or approval.

irb_address_1.label: IRB/EC Address Line 1
irb_address_1.description: The first address line for the IRB or ethics committee.

irb_address_2.label: IRB/EC Address Line 2
irb_address_2.description: The second address line for the IRB or ethics committee, when available.

irb_address_3.label: IRB/EC Address Line 3
irb_address_3.description: The third address line for the IRB or ethics committee, when available.

irb_city.label: IRB/EC City
irb_city.description: The city where the IRB or ethics committee is located.

irb_state.label: IRB/EC State/Province
irb_state.description: The state, province, region, or source-system geographic code for the IRB or ethics committee.

irb_zip.label: IRB/EC Postal Code
irb_zip.description: The postal or ZIP code for the IRB or ethics committee.

irb_country.label: IRB/EC Country
irb_country.description: The country where the IRB or ethics committee is located.

irb_phone.label: IRB/EC Phone
irb_phone.description: The phone number for the IRB or ethics committee, when available.

irb_fax.label: IRB/EC Fax
irb_fax.description: The fax number for the IRB or ethics committee, when available.

irb_email.label: IRB/EC Email
irb_email.description: The email address for the IRB or ethics committee, when available.

irb_local_central.label: IRB/EC Local or Central
irb_local_central.description: Indicates whether the IRB or ethics committee is categorized as local or central. Observed categories/values in this file: CENTRAL, LOCAL.

original_irb_ec_approval_date.label: Original IRB/EC Approval Date
original_irb_ec_approval_date.description: The original IRB or ethics committee approval date for the site and study.

orig_irb_ec_appr_exp_date.label: Original IRB/EC Approval Expiration Date
orig_irb_ec_appr_exp_date.description: The original expiration date associated with the IRB or ethics committee approval.

irb_ec_approval_exp_date.label: Current IRB/EC Approval Expiration Date
irb_ec_approval_exp_date.description: The current expiration date associated with IRB or ethics committee approval.

irb_history_summary.label: IRB/EC History Summary
irb_history_summary.description: A summarized history of IRB or ethics committee approval events, often represented as pipe-separated status entries.

protocol_history_summary.label: Protocol History Summary
protocol_history_summary.description: A summarized history of protocol review or approval events, often represented as pipe-separated status entries.

amendment_history_summary.label: Amendment History Summary
amendment_history_summary.description: A summarized history of study amendment review or approval events, often represented as pipe-separated status entries.

comments_summary.label: Comments Summary
comments_summary.description: A summarized list of site, regulatory, or operational comments and milestone notes, often represented as pipe-separated date-stamped entries.

latest_protocol_rev.label: Latest Protocol Revision
latest_protocol_rev.description: The latest protocol or clinical investigation plan revision identifier recorded for the site.

latest_prot_rev_status.label: Latest Protocol Revision Status
latest_prot_rev_status.description: The approval or processing status for the latest protocol revision. Observed categories/values in this file: APPROVED, CONDITIONAL, DISAPPROVED, PENDING, SENT, TO COUNTRY OFFICE, WAIVED.

latest_prot_rev_status_date.label: Latest Protocol Revision Status Date
latest_prot_rev_status_date.description: The date associated with the latest protocol revision status.
